content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule reproduces sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide). We have input from previous step: make_7_lvl2-apply_template-2 asked to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of task make_7_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below, answer was [] meaning no precursors found (template maybe not applicable). We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically to the molecule (target) yields precursors: amine and sulfonyl chloride. So we need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken? In forward reaction, sulfonamide formation forms S-N bond, so forward reaction forms sulfonamide functional group, breaks sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl) and amine (N-H?) Actually forward: amine (R-NH2) + sulfonyl chloride (R'-SO2Cl) -> sulfonamide (R'-SO2-NHR) + HCl. So bond formed: S-N. Bonds broken: S-Cl and N-H (maybe). Functional groups formed: sulfonamide. Functional groups broken: sulfonyl chloride, amine? The forward reaction forms sulfonamide functional group. So we can search with functional_groups_formed = ["sulfonamide"] and functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonyl chloride","amine"] maybe. Let's get list of functional groups.
